strings.name: Sam Altman
strings.summary: Altman moved from mobile start-ups into start-up incubation, leading Y Combinator before co-founding and leading OpenAI. He helped bring ChatGPT to the public, expanding the use of generative AI. His influence centers on organization-building, funding and product adoption, rather than single-handedly inventing models. His dismissal and return in 2023 also exposed tensions between AI company governance and public responsibility.
strings.coverageNote: Sources checked through 2026-11-13. The timeline selects milestones from 1985–2025; public appearances in 2026 also confirm identity. Announced company plans are not treated as completed achievements.

strings.highlights.highlight-01.title: Bringing generative AI to the public
strings.highlights.highlight-01.text: Led OpenAI as it released the ChatGPT research preview, bringing conversational generative models to a broad audience.
strings.highlights.highlight-02.title: Start-up organizations and funding networks
strings.highlights.highlight-02.text: Served as Y Combinator president, helping technology start-ups with incubation, funding and business development.
strings.timeline.event-01.title: Stargate plan announced
strings.timeline.event-01.text: OpenAI and partners announced US AI infrastructure plans; investment targets are not completed investments.
strings.timeline.event-02.title: Dismissed and reinstated
strings.timeline.event-02.text: OpenAI's board removed him as CEO; he returned that month, and a new initial board was announced.
strings.timeline.event-03.title: ChatGPT opens to the public
strings.timeline.event-03.text: OpenAI released its conversational AI research preview, a turning point in the reach of its products.
strings.timeline.event-04.title: Focuses on leading OpenAI
strings.timeline.event-04.text: Became OpenAI's chief executive, shifting his focus from start-up incubation to AI research and applications.
strings.timeline.event-05.title: Co-founds OpenAI
strings.timeline.event-05.text: Helped establish the nonprofit AI research organization and served as one of its initial co-chairs.
strings.timeline.event-06.title: Named Y Combinator president
strings.timeline.event-06.text: Paul Graham announced him as his successor to lead the start-up incubator's development.
strings.timeline.event-07.title: Co-founds Loopt
strings.timeline.event-07.text: After leaving Stanford, helped launch a location-based mobile social app and entered technology entrepreneurship.
strings.timeline.event-08.title: Born in Chicago
strings.timeline.event-08.text: Born in the United States and later grew up in Missouri.
